custodyProfile.uncertainty: Maple documents statutory ring-fencing and portfolio-limited recourse, but the legal issuer is the SPC: Cayman General Registry states that its portfolios are not separate legal entities. Structured segregation is not guaranteed insolvency immunity. Current syrupUSDG collateral custodians, allocations, reuse/repledging conditions and failure-continuity terms remain undisclosed. Lending or permitted trading does not establish particular rehypothecation conditions. Maple's July launch article broadly references Proof of Reserves, but the current independent dashboard names only syrupUSDC and syrupUSDT; no syrupUSDG-specific financial reconciliation is inferred.
